{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{use mdy dates|date=February 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2010–11 |team=Wisconsin Badgers |image=Wisconsin Badgers logo.svg |conference=Big Ten Conference |division= |short_conf= Big Ten |CoachRank=15 |APRank=16 |hc_year=10th |record=25–9 |conf_record=13–5 |head_coach=[[Bo Ryan]] |asst_coach1= |asst_coach2=[[Gary Close]] |asst_coach3=[[Lamont Paris]] |stadium=[[Kohl Center]] |champion= |bowl=[[2011 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result=Sweet Sixteen |assoc_coach=[[Greg Gard]]}} {{2010–11 Big Ten men's basketball standings}} The '''2010–11 Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Wisconsin–Madison]] in the [[2010–11 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by [[Bo Ryan]] in his 10th season as coach of the Badgers. They played their home games at the [[Kohl Center]] in [[Madison, Wisconsin]] as members of the [[Big Ten Conference]]. They finished the season 25–9, 13–5 in [[2010–11 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in fourth place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2011 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]] to [[2010–11 Penn State Nittany Lions men's basketball team|Penn State]]. The Badgers received an at-large bid to the [[2011 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 4 seed in the Southeast Region. There they defeated [[2010–11 Belmont Bruins men's basketball team|Belmont]] in the Second Round before beating [[2010–11 Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball team|Kansas State]] in the Third Round to advance to the Sweet Sixteen. In the Sweet Sixteen, they were defeated by eventual National Runner-up [[2010–11 Butler Bulldogs men's basketball team|Butler]]. == Previous season == The [[2009–10 Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball team|Badgers]] finished the [[2009–10 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2009–10 season]] 24–9, 13–5 in [[2009–10 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in fourth place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2010 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]] to [[2009–10 Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball team|Illinois]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2010 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 4 seed in the East region. There they defeated 13th-seeded [[2009–10 Wofford Terriers men's basketball team|Wofford]] in the First Round before being upset by 12th-seeded [[2009–10 Cornell Big Red men's basketball
